# DESK v0.2.2 match trade T6 (DESK v0.2.2 screen replay, same six trades as DESK_V02_MATCH.md)
Plain copy of the CSVs in autopilot/desk_v02_match/ (v022_t6_decisions.csv, v022_t6_nq1s.csv); nothing recomputed. Written for the relay's C# core to be matched decision for decision.
Notes: the decisions file has one row per 15-s decision with every seat input (s5_pts = typical 5-minute move at that decision, sigma60_pts = typical 1-minute move, unit_pts, open_s5/best_s5, bars_last8 = the stored last 8 one-minute values the class used, swings_last3, stage, posture, votes S1..S6, members/raw_feeds, stop_before, pos_before, rule, action, frac, reason). The separate 1-minute close series is not stored apart from bars_last8; the 1-s file gives the NQ mid every second from entry to exit. v0.2.1 versions of these CSVs are the files without the v022_ prefix in the same folder.
